# pve_certificate_info (Data Source)

Certificates installed on a node: full info list plus the certificate/ACME indexes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_certificate_info" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `acme_index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/certificates/acme (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `certificates` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/certificates/info. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/certificates (the API schema does not describe its shape).

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `issuer` (String) Certificate issuer name.
- `notafter` (Number) Certificate's notAfter timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `notbefore` (Number) Certificate's notBefore timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `pem` (String) Certificate in PEM format
- `public_key_bits` (Number) Certificate's public key size
- `public_key_type` (String) Certificate's public key algorithm
- `san` (List of String) List of Certificate's SubjectAlternativeName entries.
- `subject` (String) Certificate subject name.
